a: NASA funding only, no new Swift observing time: up to $1.0M in total for about 20 one-year awards
dt: Phase-1 proposals due Jan 28, 2027 via ARK/RPS (ROSES-25 Amendment 80, posted Oct 20, 2026); Cycle 23 starts about Jul 1, 2027
e: Funding for Swift archival data analysis in any area of astrophysics, theory, correlative investigations and new GRB projects. No new Swift observing time is offered, because Swift science operations are expected to end in late 2026. Only PIs at US institutions can be funded.
unv: No Phase-2 budget date is posted (only invited proposers submit one). The call does not say whether students or postdocs may be PI, so institutional rules apply.
